name: Nanase Shizuha
source:
Nanase Shizuha is a vampire traveling across Japan together with Yuna. Bashful, passive, and meek, Shizuha only wishes to live in peace and obscurity, away from those who would hunt her kind.

Despite her timidness, she digs in her heels and always refuses to consume human blood, even though it means weakening herself to the point of putting her and Yuna at a disadvantage to their pursuers. The only person she allows herself to feed on is Yuna, as she considers the act a confirmation of their bond. Her affection for Yuna makes Shizuha extremely dependent on her, a fact that Yuna finds both endearing and bothersome.

[i]"...Don’t you think sometimes that you’d be better off being human? You wouldn't be running for your life right now if you weren’t a vampire..."[/i]

[From [url=https://blog.jlist.com/product-previews-and-reviews/visual-novels/sadistic-blood-a-gory-vampiric-vn-is-now-available/]JAST USA[/url]]
